article.headline: Louis Bond, Mike Loughnane help Northeastern hold off Harvard 74-70 in OT
article.description: — Louis Bond had 22 points and Mike Loughnane scored 21, including the final four points in overtime to rally Northeastern to a 74-70 victory over Harvard on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Louis Bond, Mike Loughnane help Northeastern hold off Harvard 74-70 in OT
article.story: BOSTON -- — Louis Bond had 22 points and Mike Loughnane scored 21, including the final four points in overtime to rally Northeastern to a 74-70 victory over Harvard on Tuesday night. Bond also contributed five rebounds for the Huskies (1-2). Loughnane added seven rebounds. Rashad King had 13 points and shot 5 for 16, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc. Thomas Batties II led the Crimson (2-1) with 21 points, seven rebounds, five assists, two steals and three blocks. Jason Singleton added 16 points and Robert Hinton scored 14. Mike Loughnane made the second of two free throws in the final second for Northeastern to force OT tied at 60. Tey Barbour sank a 3-pointer for Harvard to tie it at 70 with 43 seconds remaining, but Loughnane hit a layup with 22 seconds to go and two free throws with 4 seconds left to seal the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
